title: Challenging BIG-Bench tasks and whether chain-of-thought can solve them
reasoning: The paper includes 'Causal Judgment' as one of the 23 challenging BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) tasks. Appendix A describes this task as involving 'moral, intentional, or counterfactual analysis' and determining 'how a typical person would answer a causal question about the story'. This directly relates to the evaluation or benchmarking of morals/ethics.
